perks.name: Bewildering Burst
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.

enhanced.name: Bewildering Burst
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a longer-lasting disorienting blast.

perks.name: Stopping Power
perks.description: This weapon's Kinetic ordinance can more easily stagger combatants, and grant increased target acquisition and damage against low-health targets.

enhanced.name: Stopping Power
enhanced.description: This weapon's Kinetic ordinance can more easily stagger combatants, and grant increased target acquisition and damage against low-health targets within an improved range.

perks.name: Discord
perks.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

enhanced.name: Discord
enhanced.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a longer duration. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Adhesive Ordnance
perks.description: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, detonates shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.

enhanced.name: Adhesive Ordnance
enhanced.description: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, has an improved detonation shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

enhanced.name: Box Breathing
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for an improved short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

enhanced.name: Kinetic Tremors
enhanced.description: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets. Perk activates more quickly.

enhanced.name: Redirection
enhanced.description: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones. Powerful shots consume fewer stacks.
